failure_stage: planner admission before session warming and migration

shared_design.load_definition: relative aggregate F/G load; absolute offered token demand differs by profile
shared_design.hardware_endpoint: concurrent reconstruction of warmed sessions; ongoing offered demand and power attainment are modeled

findings: The standard H100 profile inherits A100 context service and migration timing tables.

Aggregate anchor throughput differs legitimately from context-conditioned service throughput; flattening the context curves is not a validated correction. The inherited decode curve itself uses aggregate measurements across concurrency levels.
The separate contextual admission envelope rejects two first-pack sessions; the error does not establish a measured migration deadline failure.
Normalizing demand against contextual throughput instead would change the workload contract and must not be done only on H100.
The timing collector enables literal token timing and disables asynchronous scheduling; drain currently does not.
The historical H100 timing regression failed its separate live pilot validation and is not a validated replacement.
A100 is collecting regional calibration before its queued drain run; its prospective profile also combines aggregate normalization with contextual admission.
Physical network routes and vLLM versions differ across hardware arms. The comparison is a configuration comparison, not an isolated hardware-speed experiment.

required_measurements.scope: Initial route timing calibration, not validation of timing tails or concurrent eight-session capacity
required_measurements.runtime_prerequisite: Explicitly match calibration and drain scheduling, token streaming, model revision, KV representation and launch flags before collecting calibration.
evidence: exact prompt and output token counts
required_measurements.capacity_prerequisite: Document the admission model and audit every pack offline. Standard estimates remain permitted for explicitly exploratory runs. Validated physical-capacity claims require measurements at the actual contexts and eight-session configuration; single-request TPOT is not aggregate capacity.
required_measurements.timing_interpretation: Route-inclusive TTFT is not pure GPU prefill time; do not count route overhead twice.

Match timing and drain runtime flags and retain complete measurement evidence.
Freeze profiles, workload/load definition, runtime identities and network contracts for both arms.
Audit all ten packs offline, retaining demand, service utilization, candidate rejection reasons and selected actions.
Check the same policy against the queued A100 configuration without interrupting its calibration.
Run regression tests and independent critic review; use a fresh output root and retain the failed run.
